company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will join a growing and operationally focused organisation based in the Hedge End area of Southampton. Working within a collaborative finance team, you will support colleagues across commercial, operational and project-delivery functions while helping the business strengthen its financial processes and reporting.

Your new role
This is a broad Assistant Management Accountant position with a significant focus on payroll coordination. You will compile and review weekly and monthly payroll information, liaise with an outsourced payroll provider and work with HR to process adjustments relating to overtime, incentives, mileage, deductions, starters, leavers and absence. You will also check returned payroll information, allocate payroll costs and ensure submissions are complete and accurate.
Alongside payroll, you will help prepare weekly KPI reports, monthly management accounts, variance analysis and balance-sheet reconciliations, including stock-related reconciliations. You will support the oversight of accounts payable and credit control activities, assist colleagues with finance queries and contribute to improving established processes and reporting. You will work with a range of stakeholders and help ensure that accurate financial information supports effective business decisions.
What you'll need to succeed
You will have previous experience in a varied finance role, with exposure to management accounts, journals, reconciliations, reporting and payroll information. You do not need to have processed payroll entirely independently, but you should be comfortable collating, checking and submitting detailed information to an external provider. Strong Excel skills are important, particularly as some processes currently involve established spreadsheets and manual workarounds. Experience of QuickBooks would be beneficial, although candidates familiar with comparable systems will also be considered.
You will ideally hold, or be studying towards an ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualification. You should be highly organised, accurate and able to manage changing priorities, with the confidence to communicate across different departments and support other finance colleagues. A proactive approach, strong problem-solving skills and an interest in improving processes will help you succeed.

What you'll get in return
You will receive a competitive package and the opportunity to undertake a diverse and responsible finance role within a supportive team. Ideally, this is a part-time position (circa 24 hours per week), but full-time arrangements may be considered for the right candidate. Hybrid working is also available, subject to the agreed schedule and the operational requirements of the role.

description:
The Role:

Silcom Recruitment are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and highly regarded automotive accident repair centre based in the Petersfield area. Our client is seeking a professional and customer-focused Service Receptionist to join their busy Bodyshop team.

Operating from an established and highly regarded repair centre, the business provides a comprehensive range of vehicle accident and body repair services, including collision repairs, dent removal, paint and scratch repairs, vehicle diagnostics and associated repair work.

Working closely with customers, technicians, estimators and the wider Bodyshop team, you will be responsible for providing a welcoming and professional first point of contact while helping to ensure customers receive a smooth and well-communicated experience throughout their vehicle's repair journey.

Responsibilities of a Service Receptionist:

Act as the first point of contact for customers visiting or contacting the Bodyshop.

Welcome customers professionally and establish the nature of their enquiry or vehicle repair requirements.

Handle incoming telephone calls, emails and customer enquiries efficiently and professionally.

Book customer vehicles into the Bodyshop and coordinate appointments for vehicle assessments, repairs and collections.

Keep customers regularly informed regarding the progress of their vehicle repairs.

Liaise closely with estimators, technicians and Bodyshop colleagues to obtain repair updates and communicate these clearly to customers.

Coordinate vehicle drop-offs and collections, ensuring all relevant paperwork and information is completed accurately.

Assist with the organisation and administration of courtesy vehicles where required.

Communicate with insurance companies, accident management companies and other third parties when necessary.

Ensure customer and vehicle records are maintained accurately and kept up to date throughout the repair process.

Handle customer queries and concerns professionally, escalating matters to the appropriate colleague when required.

Provide customers with clear information regarding repair timescales and manage expectations throughout the process.

Support the preparation and processing of repair documentation, invoices and other administrative paperwork.

Ensure the reception and customer-facing areas are maintained to a professional standard.

Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers, technicians, estimators and colleagues across the business.

Deliver a consistently high standard of customer service from the initial enquiry through to the customer's vehicle collection.

Support the wider Bodyshop team in achieving customer satisfaction, operational and departmental targets.

Salary: Up to £35,000 Basic

title: Tenant and Maintenance Liaison Coordinator
description:
Tenant and Maintenance Liaison Coordinator
Let's Go Lettings
Location: 73 Fawcett Road, Southsea, with visits to managed properties
Salary: £28000 - £30000 per annum DOE
Hours and contract: 9am-5pm 35 hours a week (potential weekend hours required)
Reporting to: Operations Director

About the role
Let's Go Lettings is looking for a confident, organised and practical Tenant and Maintenance Liaison Coordinator to take ownership of tenant enquiries and maintenance issues across our managed properties.
You will be the first point of contact for all calls relating to tenant concerns, repairs and maintenance. This is a busy role with a high volume of incoming calls, alongside regular outbound calls to tenants, landlords and contractors. You will need to think quickly, ask the right questions and arrange practical solutions while keeping everyone informed.
Alongside your office duties, you will visit properties to investigate reported issues, gather information and check completed work. You will follow each case from the initial report through to resolution, making sure that actions are followed up and tenants know what is happening.

Your responsibilities
Handle all incoming calls about tenant issues and maintenance, together with related emails and messages, providing a professional, helpful and reassuring service.
Listen carefully, establish the facts and assess urgency. Prioritise emergencies and safety concerns, following company procedures and escalating promptly when needed.
Resolve straightforward enquiries at the first point of contact where possible, using approved guidance and sound judgement.
Log enquiries, repair requests and complaints accurately, recording the issue, agreed actions, responsibility and next steps.
Coordinate repairs with contractors and the maintenance team, arranging appointments, access and keys, and giving clear instructions about the work required.
Obtain quotes and seek landlord or management approval where required, working within agreed spending limits.
Make outbound calls to chase progress, confirm appointments, explain delays and keep tenants and landlords updated.
Track outstanding jobs and follow up missed appointments, overdue work and repeat problems until a satisfactory resolution is reached.
Attend properties to assess reported concerns, take photographs and notes, meet tenants or contractors and check that agreed work has been completed.
Handle complaints and difficult conversations calmly, investigate concerns and agree realistic next steps. Escalate formal or unresolved complaints in line with company procedures.
Recognise recurring issues and highlight opportunities to improve response times, contractor performance and the tenant experience.
Keep clear records on company systems and coordinate with colleagues so enquiries remain covered while you are attending properties.

What we are looking for
You will enjoy speaking with people, solving problems and keeping several tasks moving at once. You should be comfortable taking responsibility, making decisions within your authority and asking for support when an issue needs escalation.
An excellent telephone manner, with clear communication, patience and the ability to build trust quickly.
Experience handling a high volume of customer enquiries, ideally including complaints or challenging conversations.
Fast thinking and practical problem solving, with the ability to identify the next action and organise it promptly.
A calm, professional approach when callers are frustrated or several urgent matters arise together.
Strong organisation and prioritisation, balancing incoming calls with outbound follow ups, repair coordination and property visits.
Reliable follow through: you chase outstanding actions and check the outcome rather than assuming a job is finished.
Good written communication, accurate record keeping and confidence using email, computer systems and Microsoft Office.
The ability to work independently and collaboratively, with sound judgement about when to involve a manager.
A full UK driving licence and access to your own car are essential, as the role involves regular visits to managed properties.

Experience that would be useful
A background in complaints handling, customer service, a contact centre, housing, property management, maintenance scheduling or contractor coordination would be particularly relevant. Experience with HMOs, residential lettings or property management software would also be helpful.
Property experience is desirable rather than essential. We are equally interested in applicants who can demonstrate excellent communication, organisation and the ability to resolve problems in a demanding customer facing role.

What good performance looks like
Calls and messages are handled promptly, professionally and accurately.
Urgent concerns are identified quickly and passed to the right person.
Repairs are actively progressed, with clear ownership and regular updates.
Tenants understand what will happen next and when they can expect an update.
Complaints receive fair consideration, clear responses and appropriate follow up.
Records are complete and colleagues can see the current position on each case.

Please send your CV and a short covering note explaining your relevant experience and we will get back to you.
